description: This file contains extension methods for configuring AWS DynamoDB storage as grain storage in Orleans silo builders. It provides methods to set DynamoDB as default or named grain storage with options configuration.

classes.name: DynamoDBGrainStorageSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for configuring DynamoDB storage in Orleans silo builders.

methods.name: AddDynamoDBGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Configures the silo to use AWS DynamoDB storage as the default grain storage, with options specified via an Action.

methods.name: AddDynamoDBGrainStorage
methods.description: Configures the silo to use AWS DynamoDB storage with a specified name and options, for grain storage.

methods.name: AddDynamoDBGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Overload that configures the silo to use AWS DynamoDB storage as the default grain storage, with options specified via an OptionsBuilder.

methods.name: AddDynamoDBGrainStorage
methods.description: Overload that configures the silo to use AWS DynamoDB storage with a specified name and options via an OptionsBuilder.
